arxiv-2106-15927.title: A Robust Classification-autoencoder to Defend Outliers and Adversaries Thanks: This work is partially supported by the NKRDP grants No.2018YFA0704705, No.2018YFA0306702 and the NSFC grant No.12288201.
arxiv-2106-15927.creator: Lijia Yu, Xiao-Shan Gao
arxiv-2106-15927.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lijia Yu, Xiao-Shan Gao. In this paper, a robust classification-autoencoder (CAE) is proposed, which has strong ability to recognize outliers and defend adversaries. The main idea is to change the autoencoder from an unsupervised learning model into a classifier, where the encoder is used to compress samples with different labels into disjoint compression spaces and the decoder is used to recover samples from their compression spaces.

arxiv-2112-06865.title: Microcanonical characterization of first-order phase transitions in a generalized model for aggregation
arxiv-2112-06865.creator: L. F. Trugilho, L. G. Rizzi
arxiv-2112-06865.description: Abstract Aggregation transitions in disordered mesoscopic systems play an important role in several areas of knowledge, from materials science to biology. The lack of a thermodynamic limit in systems that are intrinsically finite makes the microcanonical thermostatistics analysis, which is based on the microcanonical entropy, a suitable alternative to study the aggregation phenomena.

arxiv-2210-16991.creator: Yuya Sasaki, Yulong Wang
arxiv-2210-16991.description: Abstract The conventional cluster-robust (CR) standard errors may not be robust. They are vulnerable to data that contain a small number of large clusters. When a researcher uses the 51 states in the U.S. as clusters, the largest cluster (California) consists of about 10% of the total sample.

arxiv-2308-15732.title: On Lie-Bracket Averaging for a Class of Hybrid Dynamical Systems with Applications to Model-Free Control and Optimization
arxiv-2308-15732.creator: Mahmoud Abdelgalil, Jorge I. Poveda
arxiv-2308-15732.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mahmoud Abdelgalil, Jorge I. Poveda. The stability of dynamical systems with oscillatory behaviors and well-defined average vector fields has traditionally been studied using averaging theory. These tools have also been applied to hybrid dynamical systems, which combine continuous and discrete dynamics. However, most averaging results for hybrid systems are limited to first-order methods, hindering their use in systems and algorithms that require high-order averaging techniques, such as hybrid Lie-bracket-based extremum seeking algorithms and hybrid vibrational controllers.

arxiv-2408-08799.title: Representation Learning of Geometric Trees
arxiv-2408-08799.creator: Zheng Zhang, Allen Zhang, Ruth Nelson, Giorgio Ascoli, Liang Zhao
arxiv-2408-08799.description: Abstract . Geometric trees are characterized by their tree-structured layout and spatially constrained nodes and edges, which significantly impacts their topological attributes. This inherent hierarchical structure plays a crucial role in domains such as neuron morphology and river geomorphology, but traditional graph representation methods often overlook these specific characteristics of tree structures.

arxiv-2410-06646.description: Abstract Using kinematic data from the Gaia Data Release 3 catalog, along with metallicity estimates robustly derived from Gaia XP spectra, we have explored the Galactic stellar halo in search of both known and potentially new substructures. arxiv-2412-07768.title: Test-time Correction: An Online 3D Detection System via Visual Prompting
arxiv-2412-07768.creator: Hanxue Zhang *, Zetong Yang *, Yanan Sun, Li Chen, Fei Xia, Fatma Güney, Hongyang Li
arxiv-2412-07768.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hanxue Zhang *, Zetong Yang *, Yanan Sun, Li Chen, Fei Xia, Fatma Güney, Hongyang Li. This paper introduces Test-time Correction (TTC), an online 3D detection system designed to rectify test-time errors using various auxiliary feedback, aiming to enhance the safety of deployed autonomous driving systems. Unlike conventional offline 3D detectors that remain fixed during inference, TTC enables immediate online error correction without retraining, allowing autonomous vehicles to adapt to new scenarios and reduce deployment risks.

arxiv-2501-16059.title: Irreversible thermodynamics and Glansdorff-Prigogine principle derived from stochastic thermodynamics
arxiv-2501-16059.creator: Tânia Tomé and Mário J. de Oliveira
arxiv-2501-16059.description: Abstract We derive the main equations of irreversible thermodynamic including the expression for the Glansdorff-Prigogine extremal principle from stochastic thermodynamics. To this end, we analyze a system that is subject to gradients of temperature and external forces that induce the appearance of fluxes of several sorts and the creation of entropy.

arxiv-2502-04019.title: Introducing a Novel Subclass of Harmonic Functions with Close-to-Convex Properties
arxiv-2502-04019.creator: Serkan ÇAKMAK 1 and Sibel YALÇIN 2
arxiv-2502-04019.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce a new subclass of close-to-convex harmonic functions. We present a sufficient coefficient condition for a function to be a member of this class. Furthermore, we establish a distortion theorem. These results lay the groundwork for extending the findings to function classes involving higher-order derivatives. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 30C45, 30C50 1.

arxiv-2510-08780.title: Weights initialization of neural networks for function approximation
arxiv-2510-08780.creator: Xinwen Hu † , Yunqing Huang § , Nianyu Yi †,‡ , Peimeng Yin ∗
arxiv-2510-08780.description: Abstract . Neural network-based function approximation plays a pivotal role in the advancement of scientific computing and machine learning. Yet, training such models faces several challenges: (i) each target function often requires training a new model from scratch; (ii) performance is highly sensitive to architectural and hyperparameter choices; and (iii) models frequently generalize poorly beyond the training domain.

pmc-11432207.title: Cerebral Embolic Protection Devices: Are There Any Indications in Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement?
pmc-11432207.creator: Neila Sayah, Ioannis Skalidis, Jules Mesnier, Antoinette Neylon, Mariama Akodad, Anita Asgar
pmc-11432207.description: Stroke following transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) is a significant and life-threatening adverse event. The vast majority of these incidents occur during the TAVR procedure or within the first 24 h following TAVR, with a notable prevalence of cerebral embolic events.

pmc-11494247.title: 18F‐Fluoro‐2‐Deoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography/Computed Tomography Measures of Spatial Heterogeneity for Predicting Platinum Resistance of High‐Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer
pmc-11494247.creator: Xin Zhang, Yuhe Lin, Dianning He, Mingli Sun, Lanlan Xu, Zhihui Chang, Zhaoyu Liu, Beibei Li
pmc-11494247.description: BackgroundThe purpose of this study is to construct models for predicting platinum resistance in high‐grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) derived from quantitative spatial heterogeneity indicators obtained from 18F‐FDG PET/CT images.MethodsA retrospective study was conducted on patients diagnosed with HGSOC. Quantitative indicators of spatial heterogeneity were generated using conventional features and Haralick texture features from both CT and PET images.

pmc-12557659.title: Narrative review of malignant central airway obstruction: management updates
pmc-12557659.creator: Sung Choi, Udit Chaddha
pmc-12557659.description: Background and ObjectiveMalignant central airway obstruction (MCAO) is a life-threatening condition that results from the narrowing of major airways due to malignancies. MCAO may result from intrinsic, extrinsic, or mixed morphologies of obstruction, which along with patient-specific factors determine treatment pathways. This review provides an updated overview of the management of MCAO, highlighting both traditional and emerging therapeutic modalities.

pmc-12564006.description: Simple SummaryThe woolly whitefly Aleurothrixus floccosus, an invasive species in Italy, was first reported in 1974. Due to the limited efficacy of insecticides, its management relies primarily on classical biological control, notably through introducing the biological control agents Cales noacki and Amitus spiniferus.

pmc-12805242.title: Cutaneous leukocytoclastic vasculitis as a nonclassical presentation of Fabry disease in an adult female patient
pmc-12805242.creator: Carolynne Vo, Jason Solway
pmc-12805242.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). described in males, heterozygous women may develop systemic disease with variable onset and severity from X-chromosome inactivation.2,3

Diagnosis in women may be delayed by normal enzyme levels and the absence of hallmark features such as angiokeratomas or renal dysfunction.2,3 Eventually, most heterozygous female patients develop symptoms often involving the kidneys, heart, or central nervous system, about a decade after affected males.3,4 Genetic testing is essential in suspected cases, especially when clinical signs are atypical.

pmc-13445931.title: Clinical presentation and survival outcome of solitary fibrous tumors of the central nervous system: a single center study
pmc-13445931.creator: Ahmet Eren Secen, Servet Guresci, Musa Onur Ozbakir, Ugur Kemal Gunduz, Ahmet Deniz Belen
pmc-13445931.description: PurposeSolitary fibrous tumors (SFTs) of the central nervous system (CNS) are rare mesenchymal neoplasms with unpredictable biological behavior, including a propensity for recurrence and metastasis. Due to their rarity, prognostic factors and optimal management strategies remain incompletely defined. This study aimed to evaluate the clinical characteristics and survival outcomes of patients with CNS SFT.
